name: MyBatis SQL Fill
description: Paste MyBatis DEBUG logs and fill parameters back into SQL to get executable SQL.
releaseNotes: Initial release: parse MyBatis logs (arrows optional), type-aware parameter fill with ANSI DATE/TIMESTAMP literals, quote-aware substitution, one-click copy.
